title: The Quiet Witness
author: Marguerite Zhou
blurb: Jude Blackwood, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
